description: This file implements the functions for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing a Tdo (Telemetry Data Object) for IP ping diagnostics within a broadband management system. It defines object lifecycle functions for a specific diagnostic Tdo related to IP ping testing, including creation, destruction, object enrollment, and initialization of member fields and functions.

classes.name: BBHM_IP_PING_TDO_OBJECT
classes.description: The primary data structure representing the IPv4 ping diagnostic Tdo object, including fields for object identification, lifecycle functions, and diagnostic parameters.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE BbhmDiagipTdoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs a new instance of the Tdo object, initializes its core properties, and sets up function pointers for object lifecycle management.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipTdoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the Tdo object, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipTdoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls required sub-objects or components needed by the diagnostic Tdo.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipTdoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes member fields of the Tdo object, including setting default parameters and linking function pointers for operational methods.
